text: Not Great. This is not great size-wise, it's hard to fit somewhere out of the way. The plunger doesnt snap into place easily which defeats the purpose I bought it so I could keep it clean and not touching anything. I'd return it but I threw away the packaging.

description: Keep your bathroom clean and organized with the Clorox Toilet Plunger and Bowl Brush Set. This two-in-one bathroom cleaning set includes a plunger and toilet bowl cleaning brush as well as a coordinating caddy for convenient access and discreet storage when not in use. The heavy duty plunger is designed with a flange cup to clear even the toughest clogs, and the long handle with comfort grip provides additional leverage for highly effective results when unclogging the toilet. It can be used with all toilets, including low-flow designs. The bowl brush with durable large round bristles makes cleaning hard-to-reach areas under the rim quick and easy, and it also features a grip handle for comfortable use. The freestanding caddy allows the plunger and brush to dry more efficiently after use while keeping the floors clean from splashes or spills, and the plunger locks into the caddy so you can carry it from room to room without dripping. This toilet cleaning set measures 6.75" x 7" x 19.5" total, making it ideal for storing next to the toilet.For over 100 years, homemakers have relied on Clorox branded products to clean and disinfect their homes. Since 2004, Clorox antibacterial cleaning tools help consumers clean and disinfect in style.
